question: On which river, the first night navigation mobile application in rivers in India was launched for ferries?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Brahmaputra.**__

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **Brahmaputra**

 
 
• **​**The **Brahmaputra **is a** trans-boundary** river that passes through **Tibet**, **Bangladesh**, and **Northeastern India**.
 
• Other names for it include **Luit **in **Assamese**, the **Yarlung Tsangpo** in **Tibetan**, the **Siang/Dihang River** in **Arunachali**, and the** Jamuna Rive**r in **Bangla**.
 
• It is the **15th **longest river in the world and the **9th **largest by discharge.
 
• The** Yarlung Tsangpo River** has its source in the** Manasarovar Lak**e region, close to **Mount Kailash**, in **Burang County**, **Tibet**, on the **northern **face of the **Himalayas**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **river **travels through southern Tibet before **plunging **into the **Mountains **in the **Yarlung Tsangpo** Great **Canyon **and entering **Arunachal Pradesh**.
 
• It enters **India** close to the** Arunachal Pradesh** settlement of Gelling and travels through **Bangladesh **as the **Jamuna** before flowing southwest through the** Assam Valley** (not to be confused with the **Yamuna **of India).
 
• It combines with the **Ganges**, also known as the **Padma** in **Bangladesh**, in the enormous **Ganges Delta**, where it then becomes the **Meghna** and eventually empties into the **Bay of Bengal**.
